svg.text: Catering · handled carton for individual lunches
CARTON NET (simplified) — 8 × 5.5 × 3.5 in body, gable handle
Hand-hole die-cut in the handle panels; end panel carries the write-in card. Crash-lock base flaps shown unprinted. Net is indicative — confirm with supplier.
